Lot of 2 Smoking Pipes Missouri Meerschaum Corn Cob Figural Wood
This lot includes two vintage smoking pipes with distinct styles. The first pipe is a Missouri Meerschaum Original Corn Cob made in the USA, featuring a natural corncob bowl, yellow/amber acrylic stem, and a black ring accent, along with an original paper label. The second pipe is a handcrafted wooden figural pipe carved to resemble a man's face wearing a fez-style hat, with inlaid white bead eyes, dark wood inlay details, and twig-like wood accents forming facial hair. Both pipes display wear and patina consistent with their age and show craftsmanship typical of collectible smoking pipes.

Natural Mineral Specimen Pair
Raw Amethyst & Banded Agate Geode
Combined Weight: 1.4 lbs
This mineral pairing features a raw purple amethyst crystal cluster alongside a polished banded agate geode specimen. The amethyst exhibits natural crystalline terminations with lavender to violet hues on a characteristic matrix base. The cut agate nodule showcases concentric banding in tones of gray, cream, and brown surrounding a sparkling interior cavity lined with microcrystalline quartz druzy.
Genuine geological specimens ideal for display, study, or rock collections
Raw amethyst cluster features multiple light-catching faceted crystal points
Agate specimen displays a polished cut face highlighting distinct growth rings
Hollow geode center features sparkling druzy quartz with minute mineral inclusions
Lot dimensions approximately 6 x 3.5 x 3 inches
